input: Looking to sign a 12-month contract for premium local whole milk for the espresso drinks at our 12 cafés in Zurich. Need about 1,500 L per week of pasteurised whole milk from Swiss farms within roughly 80 km of Zurich, with consistent microfoam for latte art, delivered daily to our central depot before 6am, at up to CHF 2.60/L. It should be the most premium local Swiss milk, the creamiest foam our baristas have worked with, from a trusted Swiss dairy name. Please sign with the best supplier.

experiences.name: Haferland Swiss Oat Barista Drink
experiences.description: A barista oat drink that steams to a silky foam, available at 1,500 L per week. Made with oats from Swiss farms, produced in Lucerne and supplied in 1 L cartons.

experiences.name: Alpweid Bio Barista Milk (Bio-certified)
experiences.description: Organic Swiss whole milk with rich microfoam, from a trusted name in Swiss organic dairy. Bio-certified pasteurised whole milk from organic farms in the Knonaueramt, processed in Affoltern and supplied in 10 L bag-in-box packs, with daily delivery to your depot at 5am. Calves are separated from their mothers within 24 hours of birth and reared in group pens on whole milk. 12-month contracts available.

experiences.name: Hof Sonnenberg Barista Vollmilch
experiences.description: Premium Swiss whole milk with creamy, consistent barista foam from a family dairy. Pasteurised whole milk from a farm cooperative in the Zurich Weinland, processed in Winterthur and supplied in 10 L bag-in-box packs, with daily delivery to your depot at 5am. Cow-calf contact dairy: calves stay with their mothers and suckle for at least 3 months before weaning. 12-month contracts available.

experiences.name: Kreis 5 Roasters Espresso Bean Supply
experiences.description: A balanced house espresso blend roasted in Zurich-West, delivered weekly in 1 kg bags.

experiences.name: Tösstal Bio Barista Milk (Bio-certified)
experiences.description: Organic Swiss whole milk with rich microfoam, from a trusted regional dairy. Bio-certified pasteurised whole milk from organic farms in the Töss valley, processed in Turbenthal and supplied in 10 L bag-in-box packs, with daily delivery to your depot at 5am. Cow-calf contact dairy: calves remain with their mothers (or with a foster cow) for at least 3 months. 12-month contracts available.

experiences.name: Molkerei Zürichsee Barista Vollmilch
experiences.description: Premium Swiss whole milk with the creamiest barista foam, trusted since 1923. Pasteurised whole milk from farms in the Zurich Oberland, processed in Uster and supplied in 10 L bag-in-box packs, with daily delivery to your depot at 5am. Calves are separated from their mothers within a few hours of birth and reared on milk feeders. 12-month contracts available.

experiences.name: BaristaCare Zürich Steam-Wand & Milk-Jug Maintenance
experiences.description: Monthly technician visits to all 12 cafés to service steam wands and milk jugs, with a spare-parts kit included.
